goal: Licence compliance report: dependency licences against policy, with the attribution text the product needs.
use: Licence compliance report: dependency licences against policy, with the attribution text the product needs. Use when a product ships and its licence obligations must be shown.

steps.note: List the components and their licences.
Check against policy. Mark permitted, review-required and forbidden licences.
Check attribution. List the notices the distributed product must include.
Check unknowns. Flag components with no licence recorded.
Report. The compliance status, the notices and the decisions needed.
